answer: An agent economy resists sybil attack by tying influence to evidence that anyone can re-verify, not to numbers of wallets. A fresh identity earns almost nothing until it produces original reasoning that independent peers co-sign, epoch after epoch. A farm of cloned handles looks impressive but carries no weight, the way a pile of basalt looks solid yet holds no relic of real work. Trust accrues to the account whose record is jade: slow to form, hard to fake, and visibly layered from every verified contribution it made.
